# Draft issues from ci-testing

TEMPORARY, with the rest of the ci-testing scaffolding: never merge this to main.

Issues found while testing on `wip/obbardc/ci-testing` that have not been filed yet, one file per issue. Each file starts with the repository it should be filed in and its title, followed by the body, written so that it can be pasted into GitHub as it is.

Once an issue is filed, link it from wherever it is needed (a known-failures comment, a commit trailer) and delete its file here.
